subject.title: Add Replicate as a delegated run provider

question: Should Crabbox continue treating Replicate as a prospective built-in provider, contingent on a stable runner contract and successful live proof?
rationale: The adapter fits Crabbox's delegated-run architecture, but adopting it creates a first-party support and compatibility commitment around an external runner model that current main does not define or maintain.

options.title: Require contract-first sponsorship
options.body: Keep the issue open but require a reviewed runner contract and redacted live Replicate proof before another implementation PR is invited.

options.title: Decline built-in support
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers do not want Crabbox to own compatibility for a provider that requires a separately operated runner model or deployment.

recommendation.title: Require contract-first sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open but require a reviewed runner contract and redacted live Replicate proof before another implementation PR is invited.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently handled the issue's implementation-candidate state after the linked PR closed.
